evidence.property_name: Andheri West Transformation: Reliance, JSW, and Shapoorji Bid for 100-Acre Slum Cluster Revamp
evidence.description: Beyond simply providing new housing blocks, this masterplan systematically fixes deep-rooted urban design flaws that have troubled Andheri West for decades. By shifting from small, individual plot clearances to a single, unified 100-acre zone, the chosen builder will have the freedom to layout brand-new connecting roads, schools, open green gardens, and dedicated drainage systems. Private landowners holding chunks inside this grid will receive developed spaces valued via town planning principles, making sure the entire neighborhood develops in a clean, modern way. Key Deliverables of the New Urban Plan: True Corporate Execution: Handing complex building work to established engineering companies rather than small, underfunded local builders. [...] | | | | --- | Operational Metric | Factual Project Blueprint | Regulatory Framework | | Total Land Coverage | 101.36 total acres (61.4 acres strictly designated as slum pockets). | Slum Rehabilitation Authority (SRA) acting as nodal agency. | | Corporate Bidders | Reliance 4IR Realty, JSW Realty, and Shapoorji Pallonji Real Estate. | Complete tech evaluation before financial opening. | | Upfront Financial Bond | ₹175 Crore cash deposit submitted by each qualifying builder. | Total elimination of traditional paper-trading practices. | | Rehabilitation Scope | Overhauling 28,061 registered hutments and dilapidated spaces. | On-site housing with modern civic grids and playgrounds. | Operational Metric Factual Project Blueprint Regulatory Framework Total Land Coverage [...] ## The Road Ahead: Andheri’s Massive 100-Acre Slum Revamp As these public upgrades fix long-standing traffic issues, buying choices are shifting heavily toward locations that offer immediate access to these new corporate developments. This emphasis on well-planned city layout ensures that surrounding properties in Andheri maintain stable, secure value over time, protecting investors from sudden real estate market drops. By pairing deep-pocketed corporate builders with strict, transparent municipal rules, the city is successfully showing how to clean up and revitalize its most crowded neighborhoods.
